capabilities: Mark abbreviations and acronyms with tooltips in Reading view, Live Preview, and optionally Source mode
Define abbreviations via note properties or Markdown Extra definition syntax
Copy note content with abbreviations converted to <abbr> tags for other Markdown editors
List abbreviations in a note and jump to their definitions
Manage global abbreviations and match supplementary suffixes
extras: README includes preview screenshots comparing Source mode with Live Preview and Reading view; no troubleshooting or limitations section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define abbreviations in a note and have them automatically marked with explanatory tooltips across views.

relations.evidence: the implementation of this plugin is similar to PHP Markdown Extra

summary: Abbreviation marker that automatically adds tooltips to abbreviations and acronyms defined in note properties or Markdown Extra syntax.
